title: CONTINGENCY CONTRACT: SEASON #4 BATTLEPLAN ARCLIGHT OPEN
lines: 01 CONTINGENCY CONTRACT: SEASON #4 BATTLEPLAN ARCLIGHT OPEN
DURATION: January 23, 2026, 08:00 – February 6, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 2-10

SEASON DETAILS: During the season, players can combine different "Criteria" in the Main Test Site and the Rotating Test Sites to clear stages. By completing tests, players can increase their Sanctuary Judgment scores and collect "Crystal Contract Bounty" (can be used to redeem rewards in the Crystallization Sanctuary). Upon completing certain "Objective Sets," players can also earn rewards such as the exclusive outfit for Aciddrop , Integrated Module Data Chunks, and season furniture.
Crystallization Sanctuary
DURATION: January 23, 2026, 08:00 – February 6, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can collect "Crystal Contract Bounty". Consume "Crystal Contract Bounty" to redeem rewards in the Crystallization Sanctuary.
MAIN REWARDS: Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Parts, etc.
02 TARGETED OPERATOR HEADHUNTING OPEN: JOINT OPERATION
DURATION: January 23, 2026, 08:00 – February 6, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Targeted Operator Headhunting, [Joint Operation], opens, and ONLY the following Operators will appear in the 6★ and 5★ Operator List of this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Entelechia / Necrass / Nymph / Qiubai
★★★★★: Alanna / Aroma / Windflit / Paprika / Gracebearer / Vendela
Note: This is a [Standard Headhunting].
03 KERNEL LOCATING OPEN
DURATION: January 27, 04:00 – February 10, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the Kernel Locating, you can pick and lock-in two 6-star Operators and three 5-star Operators as the rated-up Operators for the current banner. Correspondingly, the redeemable Operators in [Distinctions] and [Universal Certificates Exchange Area] will be shifted into: A 6-star and a 5-star Operator of your choice from the rated-up Operators for the current banner.
All possible Operators:
★★★★★★ (2%): Kal'tsit / Flametail / Blemishine / Surtr / Rosa / Weedy / Ceobe / Gnosis / Saileach / Schwarz / Hellagur / Phantom

★★★★★ (8%): Kirara / Corroserum / Whisperain / Andreana / Zima / Blue Poison / Silence / Meteorite / Skyfire / Liskarm / Astesia / Pramanix / FEater / Firewatch / GreyThroat / April / Nearl / Beeswax / Franka / Provence / Hung / Swire / Sesa / Tsukinogi
Note: The odds of getting a 6-star Operator due to accumulated rolls in the [Kernel Headhunting] before the shift WILL carry to the [Kernel Locating] banner.
04 SUPPLY & CHIPS EVERYDAY ACCESS
DURATION: January 23, 2026, 08:00 – February 6, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: All stages in Supplies and Chips stay open during the period above.
05 LIMITED-TIME PACK AVAILABLE
DURATION: January 23, 2026, 08:00 – February 13, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the following pack will be available from the Store for a limited time.
Springbay Dreams Pack
CONTENTS: Dynamic Home Screen UI [Old Dream] * 1, Dynamic Themed Background [Springbay] * 1
Note:
- The [Springbay Dreams Pack] is currently available at its first-launch discount price.
- Both dynamic Home Screen UI and dynamic Themed Background can change into different forms under certain conditions.

- The first-launch discount price for [Dahuang Sprout Pack] will be adjusted to Originite Prime * 24 after 08:00 on January 23 (UTC-7). Players who have previously purchased this pack will receive a compensation of Originite Prime * 6 after 08:00 on January 23 (UTC-7). Please check your in‑game mailbox for the compensation mail. The mail will be valid for 180 days, so please log in and claim it promptly.
Please stay tuned for more information!
